title: unified-rollouts: enhance canary/AB/shadow auto-rollback with multi-metric policies and retry windows
author: Evan Park
description: Add multi-metric auto-rollback support and retry windows for unified rollouts. Motivation: customers are running more complex canary/AB/shadow experiments that require combining signal across latency, error-rate, and quality regressions before triggering an automated rollback. This PR adds: 1) a policy schema extension for multi-metric rules (AND/OR combinations, weighted scoring), 2) configurable evaluation windows and retry/backoff to avoid flapping on transient blips, 3) support for external metric sources (prometheus, custom eval service) and decoupled thresholds per route/model, 4) automatic pinned rollback action that preserves previous model version and traffic split history, 5) observability hooks (rollout events, decision explanation metadata) and 6) unit/integration tests plus docs and examples. Implementation touches rollout controller, policy evaluator, metric adapters, API surface for rollout configs, and the console UI for policy editing. This description includes commit summaries, changed files, reviews, and CI status below.

Evan Park (author): Reply — added a normalization step and a test for missing metrics; default weight normalization now documented in schema comments.
Jonah Lee: Request changes — the migration could be expensive on large accounts. Can we do a background migration or mark-and-scan instead of a blocking ALTER?
Evan Park: Reply — switched migration to a background job that backfills policy_v2 column and leaves v1 readable; included a short-lived compatibility layer in controller.
Priya Patel: Approval with comments — LGTM. A couple of UX nits in PolicyEditor but not blocking for rollout, please follow up in a small frontend PR.
Luca Moretti (SRE): Comment — CI flakes observed on integration run due to timing; increased the harness timeouts and added retries for Prometheus queries.
